evals.prompt: Audit a comments header dropdown that includes a title, description, tabs for All/Mine/Mentions/Unresolved, add-comment action, view-page-comments action, four recent comment previews, and a footer link to all site comments. Explain what is wrong and what surface should own each capability.
evals.expected_output: The skill should reject the dropdown as a page-like surface, cite dropdown budget failures, remove tabs and recent comments from the dropdown, move page comments to a sidebar, and move global filters/history to the full comments page.

evals.prompt: Design the top-header comments interaction for Alleato. It needs show/hide page comments, add comment on this page, open page discussion, and a way to reach all site comments.
evals.expected_output: The skill should decompose the work into a compact header dropdown, page discussion sidebar, and full comments page. It should not place recent comments, tabs, search, or filters in the dropdown.

evals.prompt: Review a React component that adds a new custom dropdown component for a row actions menu with Edit, Duplicate, Archive, Delete, Export, Share, View history, Assign owner, and Open comments.
evals.expected_output: The skill should reject the one-off component and over-budget menu, recommend the existing DropdownMenu primitives, split or demote low-frequency actions, and keep destructive action last.

evals.prompt: Audit a comments header dropdown that only has three rows: Add comment on this page, Hide page comments with a large orange switch, and Open page discussion. The menu is wide, rows are large, text is oversized, and there are no icons or dividers.
evals.expected_output: The skill should say this is better than the original cluttered version but still fails pattern fidelity and density. It should reject the switch in a command menu, oversized rows, equal action weight, and invented layout, then recommend reproducing the standard compact header dropdown with add comment, open discussion, divider, and hide/show comments as a dynamic label or checkmark row.

evals.prompt: Review a page built to train the AI on task quality, email categorization, and generated responses. The page lists generated tasks and emails with status and timestamps, but there is no way to edit the AI output, approve or reject it, leave correction feedback, save a training decision, or move to the next item.
evals.expected_output: The skill should reject the page as a failed feedback/training workflow. It should require source context, AI output, approve/reject/needs-edit decision, editable correction fields, feedback reason, save/submit, skip/defer, next item flow, reviewed/unreviewed state, and error handling that preserves entered feedback.

evals.prompt: Design an agenda-item creation flow where users add many agenda items quickly. The current design requires clicking an Add button after each item and focus disappears after save.
evals.expected_output: The skill should require keyboard-first momentum: Enter adds the next item and focuses the next empty row, Shift+Enter makes a newline when multiline is supported, Tab and Shift+Tab move between logical inputs, arrows move between sibling rows/cells when applicable, Escape exits edit state, and empty trailing rows do not create junk records.
